offers_products.reason: Radio, podcasts and streaming are free to listeners; what is sold is advertising airtime, so products are not the main offering.

offers_services.reason: Sells radio, podcast, digital and live-event advertising campaigns to advertisers, plus event production.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Listeners get radio, podcasts and iHeartRadio free; advertisers are the buyers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Advertisers, from local businesses to national brands, buy ads on 860 stations, podcasts and events.

recurring_revenue.reason: Advertising is bought as campaigns and flights, not subscriptions, though some advertisers repeat.

cyclical_demand.reason: Advertising budgets are among the first things businesses cut in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Ad spots and campaigns are small, frequent purchases for most advertisers.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for audience reach through stations, streaming and podcasts, not mainly for staff time.

large_customers.reason: Advertisers include national brands but also many local businesses; no clear large-enterprise majority.

asset_heavy.reason: Mainly broadcast licences, content and digital platforms; needs studios and towers but little heavy ongoing capital.

notes: Advertiser mix and recurring-revenue share are not stated on the site; those answers are judgement calls.
